## What's new

### Full PBX backup and restore

You can now recover a failed PBX or move it to a fresh server running the same FS PBX release, including a move from Debian 11 to Debian 13.

**Highlights**

- Run `php artisan app:backup` to create a dated archive of the database, application settings, voicemail, faxes, local recordings, and custom sounds.
- Choose how many daily archives to keep with **Default Settings → scheduled_jobs → backup_keep_count**. The default is five. If your off-server backup job copies standalone database dumps, point it at `backup_YYYY-MM-DD.tgz`. The database dump is now kept inside that archive.
- Check an archive before restoring it. The restore brings back the original site address, sign-in settings, and encryption key while keeping the replacement server's database connection.
- If an earlier restore left the installer's site address or sign-in settings in place, use `--repair-env` with the same archive to recover those settings.

Use an isolated replacement. A successful restore starts installed PBX services, including FreeSWITCH, background workers, and scheduled jobs. The guide includes separate recovery steps for redundant servers. [Backup and restore guide](https://www.fspbx.com/docs/backup-and-restore/)

### Four more interface languages

You can now choose **Polish**, **Portuguese (Portugal)**, **Spanish (Spain)**, or **Spanish (Mexico)** for the FS PBX web interface.

**Highlights**

- Polish covers all 6,051 interface strings in this release. Portuguese (Portugal) and both new Spanish variants each cover 6,045.
- French, German, Italian, Russian, Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese also gained translations for My Account, authenticator sign-in, and messaging.

Choose **General → Regional → Language** in **System Settings** to set the default or in **Account Settings** to change one account. Sign out and back in to apply the change. [Language settings guide](https://www.fspbx.com/docs/getting-started/language-settings/)

### My Account and authenticator sign-in

Open **My Account** from the user menu to manage your profile, password, and two-factor authentication. The page shows which details your organization manages through its directory.

**Highlights**

- Set up an authenticator app by scanning a QR code. Once enabled, the app's six-digit code is the default at each new sign-in.
- If you lose access to the app, choose **Other ways to sign in** to use a one-time recovery code or receive a code by email.
- Update your sign-in email after confirming your current password, if your organization allows you to edit that address.

Administrators can still require email verification for users without an authenticator. Those users can remember a device for seven days. [Two-factor authentication guide](https://www.fspbx.com/docs/configuration/enable-2fa/)

### Analog line routing for Grandstream HT841 and HT881

Outbound routes can now use registered FXO ports on these gateways, including gateways behind NAT with a changing IP address.

**Highlights**

- In **Outbound Routes**, choose a port under **Public-context extensions**. Add up to two alternate ports to try when a line reports busy.
- When creating a port extension, select **Use public inbound routes** and leave its name blank to preserve the outside caller's name. Each line's phone number controls where incoming calls go.
- The updated provisioning template defaults to TCP, dials outbound numbers in one stage, and forwards inbound calls after two rings. You can adjust the ring count for your lines. [Grandstream FXO setup guide](https://www.fspbx.com/docs/phone-provisioning/grandstream-ht8x1-fxo/)

## Improvements and fixes

- Long outbound faxes get more time based on page count. If a delivery notification is delayed, FS PBX checks the sending server for a completed transmission before retrying, reducing duplicate faxes. This change requires the database migration in the [standard update procedure](https://www.fspbx.com/docs/updates/).
- Ringotel mobile app setup now reports SIP registration errors and sends activation credentials to the extension's email address after successful activation.
- Added **AssemblyAI-STT-3.7** to the transcription settings and marked the older Universal 3 Pro and Universal-3.5 Pro models as deprecated.
- The updated email guide explains how to send a test message and diagnose delivery failures. [Email setup guide](https://www.fspbx.com/docs/getting-started/email-settings/)
